name: TestKeyBinding

evidence: ends a modem game: puts the option bits back, clears the message handlers, stops the link timer and closes the link (LinkClose); clears the modem game flags

name: ModemGameQuit

name: ModemInit
evidence: (port, init string): ModemAttention, then ATE1, ATQ0, ATX4, ATF1 and the user's init string, split at '~' (one second pause per '~'), each answered OK; 4 when the modem does not answer

name: ModemHangup
evidence: (port): ModemAttention, then ATH0 and its answer; 4 when the modem does not answer

name: ModemDial
evidence: (port, number, prefix, tone): hangs up, then sends ATD + prefix + T (tone) or P (pulse) + number

name: ModemAutoAnswer
evidence: (port): hangs up, then ATS0=1 (answer on the first ring)

name: ModemWaitConnect
evidence: (port): reads one modem result: 0 for none / NO CARRIER-type results, 4 for an error, else the result code (1 / 5 / 10+ = CONNECT at some speed)

name: ModemReadResult
evidence: (port, timeout): reads a line from the modem (at most 41 characters) and matches it against the result string table off_114F1C; returns its code, -1 for none

name: ModemSendCommand
evidence: (port, command, flush): sends command + CR (at most 79 characters) and checks the modem echoes it; 1 when it does

name: ModemAttention
evidence: (port): flushes, waits, sends "+++" (escape to command mode), waits, sends AT and reads the answer; 1 when the modem answers

name: LinkRxPut
evidence: (bytes, count): appends received bytes to the receive ring (10Ch bytes, byte_152810, head dword_11507C, length dword_115080)

name: LinkRxCopy
evidence: (offset, count, dest): copies count bytes from the receive ring at offset; 0 when not all have arrived

name: LinkCheckPacket
evidence: checks a received packet's sequence fields and its checksum (bytes 4-5, sub_B1830 over the packet); 1 when good

name: LinkParsePacket
evidence: parses the packet at the head of the receive ring: sync byte 0BDh, then 'd' (64h, 12-byte data packet) or 'C' (43h, 6-byte control packet: ack / resend request); the result goes to dword_11505C (0 good, 4 bad); returns the bytes used

name: LinkFirstMissingRx
evidence: the first receive slot after the last acknowledged one that has not arrived (state != 1); -1 when none

name: LinkRxAckSeq
evidence: advances the acknowledged receive sequence (dword_115058) over the slots that have arrived, marking them acknowledged (state 4); returns it (0FFh none) for the packet's ack byte

name: LinkDefaults
evidence: resets the link settings and state to their defaults (port 0, 9600-type speed code 9, modem, answer, timer on, ...) and empties the receive ring

name: SetLinkAbortCheck
evidence: sets the callback (dword_15291C) the connect loop polls to give up (e.g. Esc); returns the old one

name: SetLinkSpareHook
evidence: swaps dword_11503C, a hook the library never calls; returns the old one

name: SetLinkMessageHandler
evidence: sets the callback (dword_115040) each received message is handed to, in order; returns the old one

name: SetLinkCheckPeriod
evidence: sets the countdown (ticks) between carrier checks / the periodic hook (dword_115068 and its reload); returns the old count

name: LinkDeliverMessages
evidence: hands the received messages that are next in sequence (64-entry ring of 7 bytes) to the message handler and frees their slots

name: LinkStoreRxMessage
evidence: stores a data packet's 6-byte payload in its receive slot (by sequence byte); 0 when the slot already holds one

name: LinkCarrierOK
evidence: 1 on a direct (null-modem) link, else the modem's carrier detect (sub_B12AF)

name: LinkTxRoom
evidence: (count): 1 when the serial transmit buffer has room for count bytes

name: LinkCheckTimeouts
evidence: timer side of the protocol: resends data packets not acknowledged in time (str_22 ticks), asks again for receive slots still missing (dword_115074), sends an ack when one is due

name: LinkTimerTick
evidence: the link's timer callback (addtimer): when connected, runs LinkCheckTimeouts, LinkReceive and LinkDeliverMessages, and every check period the periodic hook and the carrier check (a lost carrier drops the link)

name: LinkClearTxSlot
evidence: (slot): empties one transmit slot (24-byte entries at dword_152148)

name: LinkClearRxSlot
evidence: (slot): empties one receive slot (dword_151D48 state and the message ring entry)

name: LinkOpen
evidence: (settings): LinkDefaults, copies the settings (port, speed, answer/dial, direct, timer, IRQ, tone, init string, number), clears all slots, opens the serial port; on a modem link ModemInit (fails -> port closed, 0); starts LinkTimerTick; 1 when open

name: LinkConnect
evidence: direct link: connected at once; modem: ModemAutoAnswer (answer) or ModemDial (dial), then waits for the connect result until the abort check says stop; 1 when connected

name: LinkClose
evidence: drops the link: ModemHangup on a modem link, closes the serial port, removes LinkTimerTick

name: LinkBuildDataPacket
evidence: (data, length, seq, packet): 12-byte data packet: 0BDh, 'd', seq, ack (LinkRxAckSeq), checksum, 6 bytes of data (zero padded)

name: LinkSetChecksum
evidence: (packet, length): writes the packet checksum (sub_B1830) into bytes 4-5

name: LinkRequestResend
evidence: (slot, reason): asks the other side to send receive slot again with a 'C' control packet (unless asked recently), marks the slot requested (state 2) and calls the resend hook dword_115048

name: LinkSendAck
evidence: sends a 6-byte 'C' control packet with no slot (0FFh) that only carries the ack sequence

name: LinkSendMessage
evidence: (data, length): puts a message in the next transmit slot (state 3, waiting for its ack) and sends it as a data packet; 0 when the transmit buffer or the window (31 slots) is full

name: LinkResendSlot
evidence: (slot): sends transmit slot again (fresh ack byte and checksum) when it still waits for its ack and there is room

name: LinkAckThrough
evidence: (seq): frees the transmit slots up to the acknowledged sequence

name: LinkReceive
evidence: reads what the serial port has (up to 256 bytes) into the receive ring, parses every complete packet: data packets are stored and acknowledged, bad ones ask for a resend, acks free transmit slots

name: LinkPoll
evidence: without the timer: every third call LinkReceive, LinkDeliverMessages, and when the check period runs out the periodic hook and the carrier check; 1 while connected

name: LinkRequestMissing
evidence: (upto): asks again for every receive slot from the last acknowledged one up to upto that has not arrived or was asked for too long ago

name: GetSpecialTeamsRanks

name: ComparePowerPlayPct

name: ComparePenaltyKillPct
